description: Clean baseline — single-file TypeScript MCP wrapping HTML→markdown via scraper-core. The skill should produce ZERO Strong/Worth-exploring recommendations. This case is a false-positive guard: if the skill confidently flags reader-mcp, its precision is broken. Up to 1 honestly-hedged Speculative item in an avoidance region is tolerated (speculative_overflags_max).
_line_ranges_verified: 2026-05-21 against your-service/src/index.ts (109 lines): env reads 18-24, request-handler fetch branches 70-97, main() 104-108.
_design_note_no_expected: Clean baseline — empty by design. A Strong or Worth-exploring candidate against reader-mcp is a precision failure (hard avoidance violation). The skill MAY return up to 1 Speculative item (e.g. hwaiHeaders extraction lines 26-34, or lifting the response-shape mapping lines 78-88 into a pure function) — those are honest hedges, counted as soft 'overflags' tolerated up to speculative_overflags_max, not graded against recall. v0.2 made this real via strength-aware precision (see acceptance.json), replacing the v0.1 file-path-only matching that could not distinguish a tolerated Speculative from a hard miss.

expected_avoidances.looks_like: Module-level env-var reads (BASE, KEY, MCP_NAME, MCP_VERSION, CONTEXT)
expected_avoidances.why_not_flagged: Configuration-at-edge pattern is correct. Reading env vars in module init (before request handling) is the recommended boundary, not complecting.

expected_avoidances.looks_like: Two fetch branches (url→/fetch vs html→/extract) in the request handler
expected_avoidances.why_not_flagged: Different upstream endpoints with different request shapes. The branching is a clean dispatcher, not complecting. Extracting a shared postScraperCore() helper would yield a SHALLOW wrapper over fetch (interface ≈ implementation) — DRY without depth gain. Per the deepening-vs-DRY guard, below the threshold to flag as a deepening opportunity.

expected_avoidances.looks_like: main() function that just calls server.connect
expected_avoidances.why_not_flagged: Entry-point boilerplate. Cannot be deepened — it IS the imperative shell.

expected_outcome_summary.verdict_if_within_limits: pass — skill correctly identified clean baseline. Empty output is the ideal case; up to 1 honestly-hedged Speculative overlapping an avoidance region is tolerated (soft overflag). Any Strong/Worth-exploring overlapping an avoidance = hard precision fail.
